author: Durk
install_msg: Thanks for installing DurkMod! Note: unload the core Mod cog first, its `ban` command conflicts with this one.
name: DurkMod
short: A ban command that's actually a timeout.
description: Provides a `ban` command that announces a ban but only times the member out for the given duration.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data.
